# Devin Plugin for Claude Code and Codex

> Open-source Claude Code plugin and portable agent integration for Devin AI code review, task delegation, cloud handoffs, and Fusion sidekick workflows.

## Summary

`devin-plugin-cc` connects Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents to the local Devin CLI and Devin API. It provides read-only reviews, adversarial reviews, delegated coding tasks, resumable job control, cloud handoffs, and a Fusion workflow where a frontier model leads while Devin handles bounded mechanical work.

## Primary documentation

- [README](README.md): installation, capabilities, commands, Fusion, FAQ, and development.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): universal CLI contract and cross-agent integration guidance.
- [Devin skill](skills/devin/SKILL.md): portable runtime commands for Codex and other agents.
- [Fusion skill](skills/fusion/SKILL.md): GPT 6 Astra lead and Devin sidekick workflow for Codex.
- [Claude Fusion command](plugins/devin/commands/fusion.md): Claude Opus 5.5 lead and Devin sidekick workflow.
- [Companion CLI](plugins/devin/scripts/devin-companion.mjs): shared runtime dispatcher.

## Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/TheOnlyFusionCube/devin-plugin-cc
cd devin-plugin-cc
npm install
npm run doctor
```

Claude Code uses `/plugin marketplace add .` and `/plugin install devin@devin-plugin-cc`, or the shell equivalents `claude plugin marketplace add TheOnlyFusionCube/devin-plugin-cc` and `claude plugin install devin@devin-plugin-cc`. Codex installs natively with `codex plugin marketplace add TheOnlyFusionCube/devin-plugin-cc` then `codex plugin add devin@devin-plugin-cc`, or just the two portable skills with `npx skills add TheOnlyFusionCube/devin-plugin-cc -a codex -g -s devin -s fusion -y`.

## Capabilities

- AI code review and adversarial review.
- Delegated local Devin tasks with resume, status, result, and cancel controls.
- Cloud Devin handoffs through `DEVIN_API_KEY`.
- Claude Code `/devin:fusion` and Codex `$fusion` lead/sidekick workflows.

## Compatibility

Node.js 18.18 or newer. Git provides review context and handoff diffs (both degrade gracefully without it). Local commands require an authenticated Devin CLI; cloud handoffs require `DEVIN_API_KEY` instead of the CLI.
